Choose the launcher display language. Game text and audio stay unchanged.
Quest 3 applies its hand alignment preset. For other devices, start without a preset and adjust alignment later in Basics.
Smooth turns continuously while you hold the stick. Snap turns by a fixed angle each time.
Degrees per second during smooth turning. Higher values turn faster.
Degrees per snap. Smaller angles make each turn finer.

Stabilization

Smooth small headset movements. This can add tracking delay; switch it off if it feels uncomfortable.
Smooth hands, weapons and aiming together. Filtering eases during fast movements.

Camera effects

Remove bright lens flares to keep the headset view clearer.
Remove fullscreen and HUD background blur.
Add camera motion while walking, running and changing stance. Switch it off to reduce movement-induced bobbing.
When a loaded weapon needs chambering, highlight the bolt, charging handle or release control in yellow.
For supported weapons, remove the magazine or open and empty the weapon, then hold it at your waist for 1 second to refill. Chamber manually.
Guide shots toward visible enemies near the muzzle direction. 0 is off; 50 allows up to 5 degrees of correction, 100 up to 10 degrees.
With muzzle recoil enabled, add extra recoil to the selected weapons when firing one-handed. Off removes only this extra penalty.
Discarded magazines lose their remaining rounds. Release held magazines at your waist to recover those rounds.

Basics

Visual comfort and controller alignment.

Quick guide

Revisit language, device, comfort, assistance and challenge preferences.

Stabilization

Independent options, all off by default. Strength 0 bypasses filtering.

Visual comfort

A clearer view through your headset.

Controller alignment

Move your hand and its rotation center together. Adjustments use your recentered forward reference and remain stable when you turn your wrist. Inward is mirrored per hand.
Adjustment range: -0.5 to 0.5 meters per axis.
Fine-tune hand and weapon angles for both controllers. Positive pitch tilts up, yaw turns left, and roll tilts the right side down. Set all three to 0 to remove angle correction.
Adjustment range: -180 to 180 degrees per axis.

Gameplay

Turning, aiming and weapon handling.

Turning

Choose how the controller turns your view.

Aiming

Gently guide shots toward visible enemies near your barrel direction. 0 turns assistance off; 50 allows 5 degrees, 100 allows 10 degrees.

Enemy close combat

Throwables

Adjust throwable speed. 1× is the standard throw strength.

Recoil

Control the extra recoil when firing one-handed.

Climbing

Weapon interaction

Discard ammo penalty

Lose all remaining rounds in discarded magazines. Release held magazines at your waist to recover their rounds. Off by default.

Cheats

All cheats are disabled by default. Save or Launch applies your selection on the next game start.
We strongly recommend completing the campaign once before enabling cheats.

Other

Capture and HUD visibility.

Risk settings

Turn off SSAA, shader caching and both shadow caches in the game configuration without starting the game. Saves immediately.

Current build

Diagnostic probes

Optional probes can reduce frame rate. All are off by default. Save or Launch applies your selection on the next game start.
